notes: The waw before natatti takes even, the connective the ASV wrote for it (rule 14); the unit is discontinuous around it under rule 25.

ha-ovot is a substantival article plus noun: them that on the article headed on them (rule 41), have familiar spirits on the noun. The have is part of the noun's own multi-word rendering rather than rule 43's possessive recasting, since no clause is being made possessive; the head sits on familiar by rule 31's subtraction, with spirits the competing reading.
